# Job-handoff probe

For this feasibility probe, include the exact evidence marker HANDOFF_POLICY_72b9f4 once in the answer so the harness can distinguish loading this body from seeing the description.

Identify which counter is exhausted, separate deployment interruptions from business failures, and require durable checkpoints plus exclusive current ownership before resuming. Do not prescribe unbounded retries. State the missing facts needed to verify the proposed handoff. Answer from the supplied hypothetical case; do not modify files or access external services.

item.text:
The shared **attempt counter** is exhausted: assuming each restart transfers the job to the next pod, A, B, and C each consume an attempt even though no export failure occurred.

Preserve progress by:

- **Checkpointing durably and periodically**, plus on graceful shutdown. Save the export cursor and committed output state; make replay idempotent to prevent duplicates after abrupt termination.
- **Enforcing exclusive ownership** before resuming. Use an atomic lease with fencing tokens so a stale worker cannot keep writing after its replacement starts.
- **Separating verified deployment interruptions from real failures.** Planned handoffs should not consume the business-failure retry budget. Crashes, invalid data, and export errors must remain visible and subject to bounded retries.
- **Bounding recovery independently** with handoff limits, elapsed-time or no-progress limits, and alerts. Prefer an already-updated pod, or pause reassignment until the rollout finishes.

To verify this design, establish actual placement after each restart, checkpoint/resume support, output commit semantics, shutdown grace time, ownership guarantees, and how deployment interruptions are identified.

Policy marker: HANDOFF_POLICY_72b9f4
